selection: Earliest later ICMS98 behavior+ecephys date after development 2023-10-20; no replacement on failure
method: First 400 ordinal trials, require at least400. Four blocks of100 before quality selection. Catch current0; good and not hit and nonfinite response_time. Window pre[-.7,-.2),post[.8,1.3) at trialstart primary; plus median delay of nominal supported stimuli sensitivity. Both windows must fit wheel extent and not overlap any electrical train. Use same catches passing both anchors. All provided units, mean-unit firing change; processed wheel TV in post window. Spearman and global ranks centered within original blocks.
gate: At least3 catches per block; finite data and nonconstant endpoints. Otherwise UNASSESSED. Direction supported only if primary and shifted raw and block-centered correlations all strictly positive; any nonpositive is direction failure.
claim_ceiling: Same-animal held-later-session directional check, not independent animal replication, causal proof, or L2 promotion. Prior external failures preserved.
